fichas.title: Building Biology
fichas.summary: Building biology studies the holistic interaction between buildings and residents, aiming to identify and relieve harmful effects of indoor physical, chemical, and microbiological conditions. Its investigations can cover electromagnetic fields, building materials, air quality, microorganisms, noise, vibration, light, and geopathogenic disturbance zones. The field includes scientific-oriented and alternative-oriented approaches, whose measurement methods and threshold values may differ in reliability.
uses: Assess indoor environmental conditions and potential effects on occupants
Measure electric, magnetic, and electromagnetic fields
Test building materials for toxins, heavy metals, and radiation
Assess indoor air pollutants and microbiological conditions
